name: devops-automation
description: Zero-downtime deployment workflows, emergency rollback procedures, Kubernetes/Prometheus MCP telemetry, and automated incident triage.

suggestedPrompts.title: Run Canary Deployment
suggestedPrompts.prompt: Use /deploy to run pre-flight checks and execute a staged canary deployment to staging.

suggestedPrompts.title: Emergency Rollback
suggestedPrompts.prompt: Run /rollback to revert the latest deployment and generate an incident timeline.

suggestedPrompts.title: Triage Production Alert
suggestedPrompts.prompt: Delegate to @incident-responder to correlate error logs with recent commits and identify the root cause.
